summary: Smith et al. report 31 hypothalamic DEGs after adjusting for body weight. HypoExplorer estimates the KO-minus-WT difference without that adjustment in the same four KO and four WT mice. The public figures, supplement and deposits reviewed provide no author genotype-only effects for this contrast.

manualReview.summary: Published hypothalamic gene results adjust for body weight
manualReview.note: All eight hypothalamus GEO assignments match the registered sample sheet. Figure 3A labels selected genes from the DESeq2 model with scaled body weight and genotype. Supplementary Table 1 lists MetaCore enrichment P values and contributing network objects. The registered edgeR model includes genotype alone. GEO supplies per-library counts. See data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE212299/codex-2026-11-21/SEARCH_LOG.md.
reviewFlags: The historical processed-input match remains structural. This review fingerprints the public archive and registered DE table.

verificationReview.reason: Figure 3A and Supplementary Table 1 provide selected results from a body-weight-adjusted hypothalamus analysis. The authors estimated the genotype effect at a given body weight. HypoExplorer estimates the overall difference between the observed genotype groups. The source search yielded no author genotype-only result for the registered mice.
verificationReview.nextStep: A direct comparison requires the authors' genotype-only KO-minus-WT hypothalamus table for GSM6523623–GSM6523630, including gene identifiers, log2 fold changes, raw P, adjusted P, filtering and model settings.
